About the show

This sensory, inclusive dance-theatre performance is made especially for and with children with complex needs ages 7-15 years. Concessions at Citizens Theatre

Standard prices run £14–£55 in the Main Theatre and £12.50–£23.50 in the Studio. Four free memberships carry a reduced price; each needs a one-off sign-up, and none asks for ID.
